summary: Lower base-class instance field initializers so they execute before the user-written base constructor body and once per instance.

target.notes: Emit the field storage without a C# initializer and inject the lowered JavaScript initializer assignments at the very start of every generated base constructor, before the user constructor body.

semantics.order: textual field order before base constructor body

caveats: Do not hoist instance field initializer evaluation to class-definition time.

tests.name: initializer before constructor body
tests.input: class C { x = 1; constructor(){ console.log(this.x); } } new C();

tests.name: edge: initializer runs per instance
tests.input: let n=0; class C { x=++n; } console.log(new C().x, new C().x);
